description: Unit-tier coverage baseline. Scope is the `include` allow-list in vitest.config.ts — the pure-logic modules the unit tier genuinely exercises. Database-bound modules are measured separately in coverage-baseline.backend.json; merging the two would overstate both.
establishedBy: local measurement at the Wave 0 audit; corrected from the first GitHub-hosted run
lastConfirmedBy: PR CI run 19 (run id 30431556718), job `unit-tests-coverage / unit-coverage`, artifact `evidence-unit-coverage`, files `coverage/unit/coverage-summary.json` and `coverage-gate.json`, at feature head 8d7bfff09cf914e00ff5ff4587341ece261185c3, started 2026-07-29T07:24:48Z, GitHub-hosted ubuntu-latest. 1082 unit tests across 249 files, 0 failed.
lastConfirmedNote: That run measured lines 93.26, statements 93.26, functions 84.43, branches 93.41 — so functions sits 0.32 pp and branches 0.20 pp BELOW the recorded baseline, both inside the 0.5 pp tolerance. The numbers below were deliberately NOT lowered to match. Rewriting a floor down to whatever was last measured turns a ratchet into a rubber stamp: it would convert a real 0.32 pp decline into a new baseline of record and make the next 0.5 pp of decline free. The gate is passing on its own terms; if functions drifts a further 0.2 pp the gate goes red, and that is the mechanism doing its job rather than a fault to pre-empt. Raise these numbers when coverage genuinely rises; lower them only in a commit that says why.
globalNote: Lines and statements rose from 91.06 because src/shared/errors/app-error.ts was DELETED as dead code, not because anything became better tested: covered lines are unchanged at 1355 and only the total fell, by exactly the 35 lines that file contributed. Functions (84.87 -> 84.75) and branches (93.62 -> 93.61) fell rather than rose, because v8 counted that module's top-level scope as one covered function and one covered branch even though no statement in it ever executed. Both reductions are deliberate and are inside the 0.5 pp tolerance.

criticalModules.why: decides which text reaches a caller; a leak here discloses SQL, paths or tenant data
input validation, rate limiting and trusted-proxy handling are the outermost guard
optimistic-concurrency and pagination bugs corrupt data or truncate results silently
a cache that ignores tenant scope is a cross-tenant disclosure
correlation identifiers are how a workflow is reconstructed after an incident
outbox retry behaviour decides whether an event is delivered once, never, or forever
the redaction path is the last thing between a credential and a public Actions log
a missing or malformed environment value must fail at start, not at first request

criticalModulesNote: minMatchedFiles is the number of files vitest currently instruments under each prefix. A coverage include list narrows silently; without this, removing files shrinks what the floor protects while the percentage stays reassuring.
